_comment: Periscope v1.1 AWS IAM policy — attach to the periscope-server's IRSA role or Pod Identity association role. Covers #178 (Identity page), #187 (IAM resolution engine), and #188 (AWS Access tab + reverse lookup + capabilities paywall). All actions are read-only. See docs/setup/cluster-rbac.md and docs/usage/aws-access.md.

Statement._resourceComment: Scope to your cluster ARNs (arn:aws:eks:REGION:ACCOUNT:cluster/NAME) if you want least-privilege per-cluster; * is fine for a single-tenant install.

If you want per-account scoping, split this statement into two: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/* for the four iam:*Role* actions and arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/* + arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/* for iam:GetPolicy / iam:GetPolicyVersion (AWS-managed policies live in the `aws` account).

Required only when awsAccess.iamProbe.enabled=true in values.yaml (the default). Drives the exact missing-perms list on the capabilities paywall. Drop this statement if you set awsAccess.iamProbe.enabled=false; the surface stays functional with an optimistic locked-pane note.
